title: Investor Services
text:
Investor Services
As our customer, you have access to investor services based on our expertise and know-how and a specialised IT platform. As your needs evolve, you can choose between a complete investor service solution or selected services.
We are dedicated to create the best solutions for you and your investors.

Current AGMs
One of Euronext Securties' missions include connecting investors - we do that by supporting investor communication through our AGMs. Find a list of all current AGM's down below.

Discover our general meeting support
Your general meeting, our expertise
Euronext Securities offers comprehensive solutions to ensure your general meeting runs smoothly and efficiently. Discover our expertise, tailored services and practical guidance in our brochure. download brochure
Ready to see for yourself?
Euronext Securities is one of the most experienced partners when it comes to AGM support, with more than 550 AGMs per year and more than 20 years' experience across our locations.
